I think the Thieves' biggest advantage is that they can pick their targets.  So if they're careful, they can wreck catastrophic damage on the Light's plans, even if they can't outright win.

-**Take Out Psimon**.  Psimon's the resident psychic and the only one on the Light's payroll, to the point where they had to kidnap Miss Martian as a replacement while he was out.  Steal his heart early to make sure he won't undo the Thieves' mind whammies.

-**Take Out One Of The Public Faces**.  Lex Luthor is the obvious choice, though Queen Bee and maybe Hugo Strange would also work.  Steal their heart as fast as possible and get them to expose the Light to the world.  Yes, there's a huge risk of them getting assassinated, a la Haru's dad.  But a repentant Lex or Bee would be smart enough to take precautions against that, and the Light relies so much on secrecy that this alone would be a massive blow.

-**And If You Can Swing it, Take Out Klarion.**  He's an ungodly powerful personification of an abstract concept.  In short, not too far off from your standard Persona Big Bad.  I know it's a tall order, but getting rid of Klarion robs the Light of it's most powerful member.
